style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for cosy children's Japanese-learning game Galaxy Rail Crew. Match attached shiba style: flat 2D cartoon sticker, thick dark brown #2A211B outlines, clean shapes, soft simple shading, warm cosy. Top-down three-quarter camera looking down about 60 degrees. Palette deep night blue, indigo, lantern amber, deep red, brass, cream. Friendly never scary. No text, letters, numbers, kanji, watermark. For objects/characters use actual transparent PNG alpha background, no backdrop, no checkerboard pattern, square 1024x1024 full body centered with padding. Rooms use landscape 1536x896. Reference is style only except crew which must be same black-and-tan shiba.
prompts: Image 1. Landscape 1536x896. Top-down three-quarter view of the inside of a cosy magical steam-train engine cab, filling the whole image, no characters. Warm wooden plank floor, dark red and brass walls, small round windows along the top wall showing a starry night sky. Leave the floor mostly empty and evenly lit so game objects can be placed on it later (the furnace, valves, seat and racks will be separate images). A wooden doorway on the far left wall and a gap for a ladder near the top middle. No text.

Image 2. Landscape 1536x896. Top-down three-quarter view of the long curved roof of a red steam-train carriage running left to right across the middle of the image, with riveted metal panels and a small hatch. Above and below the roof: a deep starry galaxy sky with a soft milky way, tiny distant planets and glowing stars, as if the train is flying through space. Keep the roof walkway clear and evenly lit. No characters, no text.

Image 3. Landscape 1536x896. Same style and camera. The inside of a wooden cargo carriage on the same train: plank floor, a few stacked wooden crates and sacks around the edges, paper lanterns hanging from the ceiling beams, a doorway on the far right wall. Keep the middle of the floor open. No characters, no text.

Image 4. Square 1024x1024, transparent background. The same shiba mascot as the reference, but with a BLUE bandana instead of red and a little train conductor's cap. Standing, full body, centred, same pose size as the reference. No text.
Image 5. Same as image 4 but with the original RED bandana and the same conductor's cap. Transparent background, no text.

Image 6. A spooky-cute obake ghost yokai: a floaty white sheet-ghost with a wavy bottom, big round eyes, rosy cheeks and its tongue sticking out cheekily. Arms out as if sneaking. Friendly, not scary. Transparent background, no text.

Image 7. A spooky-cute kappa yokai: small green turtle-like creature with a water dish on its head, a little yellow beak and a tiny shell on its back, tiptoeing mischievously. Transparent background, no text.
Image 8. A spooky-cute tanuki yokai: round brown raccoon-dog with a dark eye mask and a green leaf on its head, grinning mischievously. Transparent background, no text.
Image 9. A cast-iron steam-train firebox furnace with its round door open and a warm orange fire glowing inside, small brass pressure gauge on top. Transparent background, no text.
Image 10. A wooden bin full of shiny black coal lumps with a small shovel leaning on it. Transparent background, no text.
Image 11. A round brass pipe valve wheel with a RED painted handwheel, mounted on a short vertical pipe. Transparent background, no text.
Image 12. Exactly the same valve as image 11, but the handwheel is BLUE. Transparent background, no text.
Image 13. Exactly the same valve as image 11, but the handwheel is YELLOW. Transparent background, no text.

Image 14. The driver's seat of the magical train: a red padded seat facing a brass control console with a small glowing blue screen, a throttle lever and two little round lamps. Transparent background, no text.
Image 15. A big red brake wheel with spokes on a brass post, train style. Transparent background, no text.

Image 16. A small wooden wall rack holding three paper charm talismans (ofuda) hanging side by side: one RED, one BLUE, one YELLOW. The charms are plain coloured paper with only a simple swirl pattern, absolutely no writing. Transparent background.
Image 17. A single plain white paper ofuda charm with a simple swirl pattern and no writing, slightly glowing, as if held up. Transparent background. (The game tints it red, blue or yellow.)
Image 18. A round wooden water barrel-tank with brass bands and a hand pump with a long lever beside it. Transparent background, no text.
Image 19. A hanging Japanese paper lantern on a short chain, glowing warm amber. Transparent background, no text.
Image 20. Exactly the same lantern as image 19 but unlit and dark. Transparent background, no text.
Image 21. A railway junction switch lever on the train roof: a brass base with a long lever arm and a round red knob. Transparent background, no text.
Image 22. A blank white station name board on two little posts, with a dark wooden frame, completely blank (the game writes on it). Transparent background.
Image 23. A cute cartoon meteor: a lumpy grey rock with a fiery orange tail, flying diagonally. Transparent background, no text.

Image 24. Landscape 1536x512, transparent background. A row of four small cute cartoon planets spaced apart: an orange ringed planet, a blue planet, a pink moon with craters, a green planet with a tiny torii gate on top. No text.

Image 25. Landscape 1536x1024. Key art: the red steam train flying through a starry galaxy over a sleepy Japanese town with glowing lanterns far below. The two shiba crew (red and blue bandanas, conductor caps) wave from the roof; cute obake, kappa and tanuki yokai cling to the side of the train. Leave the top 30% calm starry sky for a title the game will add. No text.
notes: Crew P1, blue/yellow valves and lamp-off edited from their matching base assets. Seat corrected to remove character. Objects explicitly exclude characters; ofuda requested neutral paper for runtime tint.
